note: AWS Lambda Node 24 base image for the L10 lambda runtime profile (contract §10). Digests resolved from the public.ecr.aws registry v2 API; no Docker daemon is required to verify them. The multi-arch index tag is rebuilt frequently by AWS while the per-platform manifests stay content-identical — the L10 acceptance gate (labs/runtime-matrix/lambda) pins the linux/amd64 manifest digest directly for reproducibility.
